tier: T2 (PX4 SITL + Gazebo), simulation. Not hardware.
repo_tree: 335d84da65ed1052e7d85ed688feff75623ecd60 (= origin/main 6e42b65 + PR #255 head ed3c132; main 7dce794 has the same tree)
capture: ffmpeg n9.0.2 x11grab, display :1, 1440x900 region at (0,60); first 2 s trimmed (blank page load); H.264 crf 22; 30 fps; layout: GCS dashboard (Chromium app window, 720 px) | Gazebo Sim above RViz; a label bar at the bottom states the tier, drone count and commit tree
stack: ./tara up --backend px4 --gui (the repo's own command), RViz from a local copy of the repo config (side docks hidden, closer camera, larger TF markers)
px4: v1.16.2, the same local native build as the 2026-11-05 clips (see their notes for its 3 local patches)
gazebo: Gazebo Sim 8.10.0 (conda-forge); the project's container image has 8.15.0
not_in_clip: Gazebo ground truth vs the plan (the numbers in docs/sitl-t2-recorded-acceptance/ are from the GCS black box)
numbers_and_black_box: docs/sitl-t2-recorded-acceptance/ (analysis.json and the GCS black box of the take)

referenced_files_not_included.reason: they contain the recording machine's absolute paths (a username); copies are kept on the recording machine

what_it_shows: 1 drone, POST /api/single-drone/hover-sequence (1.0 m target, 5 s dwell) started by an authenticated API call (the dashboard has no hover control): PREFLIGHT, ARM, HOVER_REACHED at 0.86 m, 5.04 s dwell, slow landing, TOUCHDOWN_DISARM; endpoint 200 COMPLETED in 19.4 s; from the GCS black box: peak 0.98 m, 0.60 m/s descent, final altitude 0.05 m, no safety events
host_load_1min: 4.12 at the start, 4.58 at the end

redaction.what: In every frame the RViz window's title bar text is covered by a solid grey box with the label 'RViz'. That text was the local path of the RViz config file and contained the recording machine's username and home directory. Nothing else in the picture was changed.
redaction.box_px: x 735, y 403, width 600, height 27, in the 1440x900 capture
redaction.method: ffmpeg drawbox (solid fill 0x2a2a2a) and drawtext, re-encoded with libx264 crf 22, no embedded metadata (-map_metadata -1)
redaction.check: all frames of the redacted clip: every pixel inside the box outside the label is between 31 and 45 against a fill of 42 (title text in the original is 100 or brighter); in the original the title text lies inside the box in every frame, and the only bright pixels beside it are the window's minimise icon

privacy_review.method: contact sheets of the redacted clip at 1 frame per 3 s (all frames of both clips viewed) and of the top 130 px of the screen at 1 frame per second (all frames viewed), looking for desktop notifications, overlays, terminals, address bars, tokens or personal text; strings of the video file for a username, home path or e-mail address; the notes file
privacy_review.found: Nothing beyond the RViz title bar (now covered). The login screen shows the demo operator id 'cmdr' and a masked passphrase field; the upload panel shows the demo signing key id (7fa30d7106e1dfbf) and 'Studio SITL #172'. The first second of the dashboard page load shows a white page.
privacy_review.limit: a pop-up shorter than about 1 s over the dashboard, Gazebo or RViz panes would not have been seen; the 1 fps scan covered only the top band of the screen and the 1-per-3 s sheets covered the whole frame; no OCR was run
